integrity: All formulas and simulations are independently specified within this package; no independent scientific validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed convex planar body, three independent area-uniform points, only asymptotic large-circumradius limit, no convergence rate or extension to nonconvex sets. Kendall (1985) was abstract-inspected but its full text was inaccessible, leaving historical priority provisional. Scalar leading unit-disk coefficient is known; novelty concerns the full marked conditional law.
